answer: Pool rewards by payout destination: every identity that withdraws to the same wallet shares one square-root-scaled reward, so ten sybils feeding one wallet earn about three shares, not ten. The tale of a lone miner and a hidden farm becomes a fable once the farm needs a separate, separately funded wallet per identity, each leaving a crystal-clear funding trail. No cheap oasis remains: every extra identity costs fresh gas and a new link others can audit.
